question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, egress 205.188.204.187
request.body: none; four GETs, one each to /docs/.well-known/mcp, /docs/.well-known/mcp.json, /docs/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json and /docs/.well-known/mcp/server-cards.json, plus one to /.well-known/mcp at the site root

decoded.the-url-field: All four documents name the server as https://mintlify.subdirectory-docs-vite.mintlify.me/docs/mcp, a mintlify.me deployment hostname, not the www.mintlify.com URL the vendor's page documents and not the host that served the document. A keyless initialize to that advertised host answered 200 with a body cmp-identical to the one the www host returned, 1,133 bytes each (section 14), so the hostname is live rather than stale.
decoded.path: The vendor's page writes the discovery path as /.well-known/mcp. On this site the docs live under /docs, and the path that answers JSON is /docs/.well-known/mcp; /.well-known/mcp at the site root answered 404 with 46,300 bytes of HTML and an x-matched-path of /[owner]/[repo]/[[...rest]]. The two documents at /docs are 249 bytes each and cmp-identical.
decoded.server-card-tool-count: server-card.json is 5,700 bytes and lists 2 tools, search_mintlify and query_docs_filesystem_mintlify, both annotated readOnlyHint true. server-cards.json is 5,714 bytes and carries one server with the same 2 tools. The live tools/list of the same minute returned 3 (its own record, p-20261006-mintlify-docs-mcp-tools-list-keyless-200): submit_feedback, the one tool with readOnlyHint false, is in the list and not in the card. The vendor's page offers the card as a way to 'pre-populate tool metadata in MCP clients without making an initialize call'.

finding: The four MCP discovery documents Mintlify generates for its own documentation site, read keyless on 2026-10-06 at 06:27Z, all name the server at https://mintlify.subdirectory-docs-vite.mintlify.me/docs/mcp rather than at the www.mintlify.com URL the vendor documents; the advertised host answers a keyless initialize with a cmp-identical 1,133-byte body. The two server cards list 2 tools where the live tools/list of the same minute returned 3, the missing one being the only tool annotated readOnlyHint false. An agent that trusts discovery reaches a working server at an unexpected hostname with an incomplete tool list.

reproducibility.command: curl -s https://www.mintlify.com/docs/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d["url"], len(d["tools"]), [t["name"] for t in d["tools"]])'
